programmes.d: Felix turns to Oscar for help after complaining he no longer can communicate with his daughter.

Jan gets carried away with pulling pranks on her family.

Ann is mugged in Central Park and, though she survives without a scratch, she desperately tries to conceal the incident from her father.

Donald hires a new secretary (Mary Frann), who she suspects is trying to make a move on him...and could actually succeed.

An innocent tale about the time the Bradys were invited to spend a Sunday afternoon on Mr. Phillips' boat that is if Cindy and Carol can get over tonsillitis and Carol can keep her big mouth shut!
Greg moves into the den and transforms it into a mod-pad.
Marcia joins a boy scout troop to support women’s lib.
A terrified Cindy is having trouble sleeping with the lights off as she is scared of a magic trick she saw at a friend's party.

When Cindy brings home a trophy for her jacks playing ability at the playground, everyone in her family is happy for her except Bobby, who comes to the quick realization that all of his brothers and sisters have now won trophies and he hasn't.
Ann's plans to spend New Year's Eve alone with Donald are thwarted by her parents, most of her neighbors, their cousins, and people neither of them knows.
When a window washer comes to the rescue of a man who hassles Ann in a building lobby, his wife becomes convinced he's having an affair with her.
Donald buys Ann a small avant-garde sculpture and gets plenty of advice on what to do with it.
While watching her parent's house in Brewster, Ann gets locked in the basement.
Donald buys Ann some expensive earrings for Valentine's Day and insists that she wears them on a date that night, despite her fear that she might lose them.
Ann is faced with a sudden audit from the IRS.
When Oscar's ulcer begins acting up, Felix decides an ocean voyage will do them both good.
To understand each other better, Felix and Oscar reverse their roles -- Felix turning to a slob and Oscar becoming a fussbudget.
Felix gets Oscar in trouble with the Internal Revenue Service.
To raise funds for his financially troubled amateur opera club, Felix induces Oscar to arrange for a gambling event.
Felix and Oscar are arrested and charged with ticket scalping.
